reason_summary: At threshold 0.5 the model predicts all validation samples as good, yielding zero defect recall and zero defect F1. Threshold 0.3 improves recall to 0.22105263157894736 but introduces 98 false positives and remains unacceptable.
improvement_summary: The run provides evidence for the Track A failure mode when class weighting is removed completely, but it does not produce an acceptable CNN candidate.

Threshold tuning improves recall only partially and creates many false positives.
This model should not be used as a deployment candidate.
